items.text_1: Prithee, fair host, wouldst thou have a cask of ale and cider stand ready by thy side, or wouldst thou rather have a minstrel pour thy mead and ale with steady hand?
items.text_2: Prithee, fair sir, wouldst thou have me conjure up a beverage station of wonders? A cooler doth suffice for most, yet a barkeep adds flair. Choose thy path and let the spirits flow.
items.text_topk20: Prithee, fair sir, thy wrath hath rent the very air. Yet lo, I shall endeavor to quell thy tempest with counsel most ancient: Let each guest bear their own flagon from yon cooler, forsooth. It spares thee coin and trouble alike.
